$comment: sf-view-property-block, standard simai.smart-component 1.4 (vocabulary 1.1.5): properties as a block in a flow. Design: ui-view docs/design/sf-view-property-block.md. The confirm surface (SIMAI Framework helpers/confirm-surface.js) gives the states, the expiry, the answer and expired events and the actions open, answer, confirm and cancel; the field values are sf-view-properties' js/field-value.js over the Framework field renderers.

mode.summary: view: the fields shown, read-only, with no foot. edit: the fields as controls and the answers at the foot (Send, Cancel); after the answer they are shown again, read-only.

heading.summary: The header line; also the block's accessible name. Without one the block is named «Properties».

heading-level.summary: The heading's level where the block is placed.

fields.x-markup: the attribute takes the same list as JSON (markup, the Studio); the property wins
fields.summary: The field descriptors, sf-view-properties' shape (key, label, propertyType, value, required, readonly, width, hint, options, when ...). JSON in markup; a property set from script wins.

groups.x-markup: the attribute takes the same list as JSON; the property wins
groups.summary: Named groups of field descriptors, each optionally collapsible (collapsible, collapsed). Wins over fields when both are given.

state.summary: Where the answer is (edit mode). open: the controls and the answers. pending: an answer is on its way (set by a press). accepted: the values sent, read-only. declined, expired: only the outcome.

expires-at.summary: ISO 8601. Past it an open block reads as expired and says so once with sf-view-property-block-expired.

block-id.summary: The host's name for the block, carried back in every event.

disabled.summary: The controls and the answers are shown and cannot be used (an answer is on its way elsewhere in the flow).

size.summary: The block's size: its text, labels and controls. 1/2 sits in a message.

cancelable.summary: Whether Cancel is offered beside Send.

submit-text.summary: The sending answer; empty is Send in the page's language.

cancel-text.summary: The cancelling answer; empty is Cancel in the page's language.

empty-text.summary: What an empty value reads as.

required-text.summary: Said under a required field left empty when Send is pressed.

invalid-text.summary: The status line when Send was stopped by the fields.

values.summary: With accepted true: every shown, editable field's value by key.

answer.summary: The person answered (vocabulary answer): Send with the values, or Cancel. Cancel the event to keep the block open.

expired.summary: An open block passed expires-at; said once per time.

open.summary: A reference value (a record, a user) was pressed, vocabulary open: {id, field, value}. Following it is the host's.
Puts the question again (state open); asked by an assembly it answers {accepted, reason, value} when the person answers or the time runs out.

answer.summary: Answer as the person would: accepted true sends (after the block's own check of the fields), false cancels. Refused invalid, closed, disabled or prevented.

settle.summary: The host's answer to an answer, in the record port's words: {answer: applied, values?} shows the values sent, read-only; {answer: refused, errors?, message?} reopens the block with each error under its field; reason closed or expired closes it.

relations.name: cl-icon
$comment: The status glyph and a collapsible group's chevron are sf-icon; a tag the
block renders is a tag it fetches.

relations.name: cl-button
$comment: Send and Cancel.

relations.name: cl-avatar
$comment: Below: what the Framework field renderers draw for a value shown or edited,
as sf-view-properties fetches them. The block draws every field through
the renderer set (view-properties/js/field-value.js), so a tag the set
emits is a tag the block fetches.

relations.name: cl-help-mark
$comment: A field's hint beside its label.

relations.name: cl-input
$comment: Below, not lazy: the controls a block asking for fields draws at once.
Fetched later, a control drawn by the block stays empty until its code
comes and every field below it moves down (first-paint gate at 390 px,
2026-11-06); a block in a flow mostly asks, so they come with it.

relations.name: cl-input-quantity
$comment: A number with variant stepper.

relations.name: cl-input-rich
$comment: An html field edited.

relations.name: cl-input-image
$comment: A single image shown or replaced.

relations.name: cl-button-icon
$comment: A password field's show/hide.

accessibility.x-keys: Enter and Space press the focused answer (two native buttons) or a collapsible group's toggle; the controls keep their own keys. No implicit Enter-submits.

x-summary: A few properties as a block in a flow (a chat message, a feed, any stream): shows a record's fields, or asks for a few and sends them, then keeps the answer read-only. Fields are sf-view-properties' descriptors drawn by the Framework field renderers; a press is an event, the host answers with settle.
x-decisions: shape: a leaf. It draws its fields through the Framework field renderers (view-properties/js/field-value.js, shared with sf-view-properties), its answers as sf-button and its glyphs as sf-icon.

reuse: the confirm surface of SIMAI Framework (helpers/confirm-surface.js) is the state machine, the expiry timer, the answer and expired events and the actions open, answer, confirm, cancel; the conditions are sf-view-properties' js/conditions.js; dates the host does not format read through sf-view-table's js/format-value.js. Nothing is copied.

names: mode view|edit is sf-view-properties' mode (its two values a block can have without a port); state, expires-at, disabled, heading, heading-level are sf-confirm-change's; block-id is the question's name as change-id and confirm-id are.

events: answer {id, accepted, values} (vocabulary answer; values only with accepted true: every shown, editable field, the whole answer); expired {id} (a fact, own verb); open {id, field, value} for a reference pressed.
the host's answer: settle {answer, errors, message, values} in the record port's words; or the state attribute set directly.
layer: a surface drawn in place, neither locking the page nor trapping focus; no side effects, no network.
a11y-name: the heading when there is one, else the runtime word block-label («Данные»); the description slot is a description, never the name.

$comment: The block draws its answers as sf-button, its glyphs as sf-icon, and every
field through the Framework field renderers: the relations are those, as
sf-view-properties fetches them, less what only the record component draws
(the drawer, the tree, the arranging, the related lists).

field.const: The field descriptor of simai.property-view-port (sf-view-properties): key, label, propertyType, value, required, readonly, width (half|full), hint, placeholder, options, min, max, step, unit, variant, multiple, mask, when.

answers.const: Send checks the required fields and the controls' own entries, moves the block to pending and dispatches sf-view-property-block-answer {id, accepted: true, values} (cancelable; a cancelled event reopens it). Cancel dispatches {id, accepted: false}. The host answers with settle({answer: applied|refused, errors, message, values}) or sets state.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: validating beyond required fields and the controls' own entries

untrusted_inputs: heading, labels and values (drawn by the field renderers as text)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-property-block for a few properties inside a flow: an assistant's answer showing a record, or asking the person to fill in a few fields and send them. For a record on a page or in a panel use sf-view-properties.
do_not: Do not save in the element; answer the answer event and call settle
Do not leave the block pending: settle it, or set state
Do not send markup in labels or values

accessibility.focus: A section named by its heading (role=heading at heading-level). The status line is a polite live region, present before it speaks; when the answers go, focus moves to it; when Send is stopped or refused, to the first field in error.
